d.ko: A classic turn-based strategy card game that allows players to collect various creature cards and skill cards through quests, upgrades, and trading. Players can select their favorite cards to craft a unique deck for battles, immersing themselves in the excitement of strategic gameplay!
d.en: A classic turn-based strategy card game that allows players to collect various creature cards and skill cards through quests, upgrades, and trading. Players can select their favorite cards to craft a unique deck for battles, immersing themselves in the excitement of strategic gameplay!
d.zh: 《火焰征程》是一款经典回合制战棋竞技卡牌游戏，玩家可通过任务、强化、交易等途径收集不同的兵种卡牌及技能卡牌，并从中选择心仪的卡牌组合出自己独一无二的卡组进行对战，体验到策略快感！
